import json

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls
from dspy.adapters.utils import parse_value

ta = TypeAdapter(ToolCalls)

single = {"name": "foo", "args": {"x": 1}}
pair = [
    {"name": "foo", "args": {"x": 1}},
    {"name": "bar", "args": {"y": 2}},
]
canonical = {"tool_calls": pair}

# --- direct validate_input calls ---
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(canonical)
assert r == canonical, r
print("canonical dict passthrough:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input(single)
assert r == {"tool_calls": [single]}, r
print("single dict wrapped:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input(pair)
assert r == {"tool_calls": pair}, r
print("bare list wrapped:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(single))
assert r == {"tool_calls": [single]}, r
print("json single dict string:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(pair))
assert r == {"tool_calls": pair}, r
print("json list string:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(canonical))
assert r == canonical, r
print("json canonical string:", r)

r = ToolCalls.validate_input("this is not json at all")
assert r == "this is not json at all", r
print("non-json string unchanged:", r)

# --- end-to-end construction via pydantic ---
tc = ToolCalls(tool_calls=pair)
assert len(tc.tool_calls) == 2 and tc.tool_calls[0].name == "foo"
print("ToolCalls(tool_calls=...) OK")

tc = ToolCalls(**single)
assert len(tc.tool_calls) == 1 and tc.tool_calls[0].name == "foo" and tc.tool_calls[0].args == {"x": 1}
print("ToolCalls(**single) OK")

tc = ta.validate_python(pair)
assert isinstance(tc, ToolCalls) and len(tc.tool_calls) == 2
print("TypeAdapter.validate_python(list) OK")

tc = ta.validate_python(single)
assert isinstance(tc, ToolCalls) and len(tc.tool_calls) == 1
print("TypeAdapter.validate_python(single dict) OK")

tc = ta.validate_python(json.dumps(pair))
assert isinstance(tc, ToolCalls) and len(tc.tool_calls) == 2
print("TypeAdapter.validate_python(json string) OK")

# from_dict_list still works
tc = ToolCalls.from_dict_list(pair)
assert tc.format() == [
    {
        "type": "tool_calls",
        "tool_calls": [
            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "foo", "arguments": {"x": 1}}},
            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "bar", "arguments": {"y": 2}}},
        ],
    }
]
print("from_dict_list + format OK")

# --- parse_value flows (adapter path) ---
v = parse_value(single, ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(v, ToolCalls) and v.tool_calls[0].name == "foo"
print("parse_value(single dict) OK")

v = parse_value(pair, ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(v, ToolCalls) and len(v.tool_calls) == 2
print("parse_value(list) OK")

v = parse_value(json.dumps(pair), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(v, ToolCalls) and len(v.tool_calls) == 2
print("parse_value(json list string) OK")

v = parse_value(json.dumps(single), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(v, ToolCalls) and len(v.tool_calls) == 1
print("parse_value(json single string) OK")

v = parse_value(canonical, ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(v, ToolCalls) and len(v.tool_calls) == 2
print("parse_value(canonical dict) OK")

# invalid input should raise
try:
    parse_value("complete garbage %%", ToolCalls)
    raise AssertionError("expected pydantic.ValidationError")
except Exception as e:
    print("garbage raises:", type(e).__name__)

try:
    ToolCalls(**{"foo": "bar"})
    raise AssertionError("expected validation error")
except Exception as e:
    print("bad dict raises:", type(e).__name__)

# model_dump / revalidation round trip
tc = ta.validate_python(canonical)
tc2 = ta.validate_python(tc.model_dump())
assert tc2 == tc
print("round trip OK")

# existing instance passthrough
tc3 = ta.validate_python(tc)
assert tc3 == tc
print("instance revalidation OK")

print("ALL GOOD")

assert ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(pair)) == {"tool_calls": pair}
assert ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(canonical)) == canonical
assert ToolCalls.validate_input("this is not json at all") == "this is not json at all"
assert ToolCalls.validate_input(None) is None

# end-to-end construction
tc = ToolCalls(tool_calls=pair)
assert len(tc.tool_calls) == 2
tc = ToolCalls(**single)
assert tc.tool_calls[0].name == "foo" and tc.tool_calls[0].args == {"x": 1}
assert isinstance(ta.validate_python(pair), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(ta.validate_python(single), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(ta.validate_python(json.dumps(pair)), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(ta.validate_python(json.dumps(single)), ToolCalls)
assert isinstance(ta.validate_python(canonical), ToolCalls)

assert isinstance(tc_again, ToolCalls)

assert tc.format() == [
    {
        "type": "tool_calls",

            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "foo", "arguments": {"x": 1}}},
            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "bar", "arguments": {"y": 2}}},
        ],
    }
]
tc_empty = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([])

print("from_dict_list/format OK")

        raise SystemExit(f"expected error for {bad!r}")
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        assert type(e).__name__ in ("ValidationError", "AdapterParseError"), e
print("invalid inputs raise OK")
